messages:
Anya (PM): proposing we use a simple customer risk score to prioritize compliance work (BYOK, retention SLAs, SOC2 evidence). small, operationalizable signal instead of ad-hoc customer requests
Raj (Eng): love the idea. what inputs do you have in mind for the score?
Anya (PM): start with: monthly active tokens, contract tier, regulatory flag (gdpr/finserv), and number of open legal/compliance asks. weighted sum.
Sylvia (Security): can we add historical incidents and external audit requests? that'll bump sensitivity for SOC2/ISO efforts.
Kevin (Sales): +1. sales will feed in priority enterprise prospects — customers who would pay for reserved capacity or BYOK. i'll supply a short list.
Maria (Legal): need to ensure score doesn't become a gating product decision without legal review. also document opt-outs for customers under special contracts.
Anya (PM): agreed. proposal: pilot the score for Q3 roadmap decisions. use it to pick top 8 customers for BYOK pilot and top 5 for extended retention SLAs.
Raj (Eng): engineering asks: clear acceptance criteria (latency SLOs, query window for audit logs), and a predictable effort estimate per customer.
Anya (PM): draft acceptance criteria: 1) retention configurable per-tenant to 7/30/90/365 days, 2) BYOK handshake completes within 3 business days for pilot, 3) audit log export available via API with 99.9% delivery SLA. open to feedback.
Sylvia (Security): those look reasonable. for BYOK we need KMS attestation steps and rotation policy in the docs. also threat model for key escrow.
Raj (Eng): estimated dev work: core retention toggle + export API ~3 sprints, BYOK handshake + KMS integration ~4 sprints, per-customer oncall/support ~1 sprint spread. rough.
Kevin (Sales): timeline check: customers want pilots starting early Q4. can we do a fast-track for 2 customers with minimal integration?
Anya (PM): yes — fast-track variant: no BYOK, extended retention only + higher support SLA. use risk score threshold to pick candidates.
Maria (Legal): for fast-track, legal requires a short addendum template with data handling and retention terms. i'll draft it.
ops-bot: scheduled: sync meeting created for 2024-10-03 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent)
Raj (Eng): one more: we should instrument the score in the dashboard so product/eng can see which customers bumped priorities. transparency helps.
Anya (PM): good call. propose a dashboard tile: customer risk score + contributing factors + recommended action (BYOK/Retention/SOC2 prep).
Sylvia (Security): add a column for compliance owner and last-audit date.
Kevin (Sales): i'll upload customer list + contract tiers before Wed.
Anya (PM): i'll circulate the pilot acceptance checklist and a tiny config snippet for retention we'll test with customers:
Anya (PM): ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "retention_days": 90,
  "audit_export_enabled": true,
  "byok_requested": false
}
```
Raj (Eng): thanks — i'll slot this into a spike to validate export delivery and perf impact.
Maria (Legal): i'll attach the addendum draft to the meeting notes.
Anya (PM): next steps: 1) Kevin uploads candidate list (by Wed), 2) Maria drafts addendum (end of week), 3) Raj does spike (2 weeks), 4) Sync 10/3 to pick pilot customers.
Kevin (Sales): noted.
Sylvia (Security): +1. also flag any customers in high-risk jurisdictions for extra review.
Anya (PM): thanks all. keeping this short — if anyone thinks the scoring inputs miss something call it out here. otherwise i'll move to a PRD draft after Kevin's list.
